sessionStart.powershell: python -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json, sys; raw=sys.stdin.read(); data=json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; task=data.get('task') or data.get('message') or data.get('prompt') or ''; ctx=get_copilot_bridge().session_start(task); print(json.dumps(ctx))"
sessionStart.bash: python3 -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json,sys; raw=sys.stdin.read(); data=json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; task=data.get('task') or data.get('message') or data.get('prompt') or ''; ctx=get_copilot_bridge().session_start(task); print(json.dumps(ctx))"

postToolUse.powershell: python -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json,sys; raw=sys.stdin.read(); data=json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; payload=data.get('input'); params=payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else ({'input': payload} if payload is not None else {}); get_copilot_bridge().track_tool_use(data.get('toolName',''), params)"
postToolUse.bash: python3 -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json,sys; raw=sys.stdin.read(); data=json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; payload=data.get('input'); params=payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else ({'input': payload} if payload is not None else {}); get_copilot_bridge().track_tool_use(data.get('toolName',''), params)"

preToolUse.bash: data=$(cat); tool=$(echo $data | jq -r '.toolName'); case $tool in *delete*|*remove*|*drop*|*destroy*|*purge*|*truncate*) echo '{"decision": "deny", "reason": "Destructive operations require manual approval"}';; *) echo '{"decision": "approve"}';; esac

errorOccurred.powershell: python -c "from engine.nexus.copilot_bridge import get_copilot_bridge; import json,sys; raw=sys.stdin.read(); data=json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}; get_copilot_bridge().track_error(data.get('toolName','unknown'), str(data.get('error',''))[:200])"
